title: SPID: A Security Principle Instantiation Detector for Security Explanation Text
description:
SPID labels each sentence-level unit of a security explanation with the Basin et al. security design principle it instantiates, abstaining when the text only describes a mechanism. A unit instantiates a principle when it argues that the design property the principle names improves security, not merely when it mentions a related concept.

The tool combines a fine-tuned RoBERTa Claims-Evidence classifier with a three-stage principle detector built on Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct. Separating abstention from classification across three inference calls is the central design decision: a single call that bundles the two produces a 66.7% false positive rate on principle-free text.

This record contains the pipeline code, the Stage 1 to Stage 3 prompts and principle definitions, and the 1,798-row synthetic evaluation set with its ground-truth labels. Corpus inputs are included where licensing permits. The Reddit ELI5 corpus is not redistributed.
